description_en: Retrieves the download URLs of offline logs for live stream relay by calling DescribeLivePushProxyLog
description_zh: 通过DescribeLivePushProxyLog，获取直播转推离线日志下载地址
kebab_example: aliyun live describe-live-push-proxy-log --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --page-size 300 --page-number 2 --start-time 2023-09-20T08:00:00Z --end-time 2023-09-20T09:00:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLivePushProxyLog

parameters.help_en: The ingest domain. Multi-domain queries are not supported
parameters.help_zh: 推流域名。不支持多域名查询
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The page size. Valid values: \[1, 1000\]. Default value: 300
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小。取值范围：\[1, 1000\]，默认值为300
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Default value: 1. Valid values: [1, 9223372036854775807]
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query logs.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
获取日志起始时间。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query logs.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
获取日志结束时间。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: end_time
